info.title: sys-ftpd Next
info.author: nyanpasu64
info.details:
Continuation of cathery's sys-ftpd, fixing multiple crashes.

AI use: Human-written.

changelog:
1.0.6:
- Fix out-of-memory errors when transferring many files and folders (shrink TCP buffers before closing sockets)
- poll() all FTP sessions from top-level function, instead of spinning in the background
- Ship default config as template path, rename to actual path if missing
- Fix infinite loop hang when processing path with `/..`
